# Dispatch C ADR: presentation behind explicit domain channels

Status: proposed for integration review, 2026-09-09.

## Decision

Extend the existing PI world plugin with capability-negotiated business panels. Keep UI-only width preferences in local storage; keep world, library, memory, task budgets and backup truth in the existing trusted domain. Every asynchronous display result belongs to the captured world epoch. The host supplies session/project identity and validates all writes again.

## Rationale

Parallel implementation can produce UI before every domain channel is available. Explicit capabilities let the shipped interface remain honest without injecting fake successful records. Exact library references and opaque backup grants prevent UI convenience from silently choosing a different version or broadening filesystem authority. Selection is a bounded context reference, not a general agent command.

## Consequences

The workbench can be built and verified with labelled fixtures, but integration remains incomplete until the root exposes each listed channel and the native pipeline is exercised. Create/Play changes panel width only; it does not drop the upstream chat or replace native composition. Multi-profile backup replacement requires a specific confirmation in the product UI, independent of the user's permission to develop the feature.
